paragraphs.text: Retry ctx.fs.writeText on Windows ReplaceFileW failures (Win32 1175) — DSH plugin
# dsh-fs-retry
Retry `ctx.fs.writeText` on Windows `ReplaceFileW` failures (Win32 **1175**).
## Why

On Windows, `dsh-fs-local` publishes file writes with `ReplaceFileW`. When the target
is briefly hel

d (indexer, AV, cloud-sync filter), it fails with `Win32 1175` and the
whole tool call dies — even t
hough a retry succeeds.
Measured on one machine (`D:` volume, 8k random chars, 50 rounds per directory):
| operation | failures |

| `ReplaceFileW` on `C:` (3 dirs) | 0 / 40, 0 / 40, 0 / 40 |
| `ReplaceFileW` on `D:` (3 dirs) | 18

/ 40, 9 / 40, 20 / 40 |
| `MoveFileEx(MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING)` on `D:` | 0 / 40 |
| `ReplaceFileW
` + up to 5 backoff retries on `D:` | 0 / 50 |

`chkdsk /scan` clean; suspending every user-mode candidate (AV GUI, indexer, backup
agent) did not c

hange the rate. The volume carries `wcifs` and `FileCrypt` filter
instances that the working volume

does not — that is the working theory, not a
proven cause.

Upstream fix belongs in `dsh-fs-local`: fall back to `rename` on any Windows replace
failure, not on

ly on `ENOENT`. Until that lands, this plugin retries at the service
boundary.
## Install
Lives in a DSH profile, not in `app.asar` — app updates do not overwrite it.

Three cases: retries then succeeds · non-1175 is not retried · gives up after 8
attempts (~340 ms of

s: retries then succeeds · non-1175 is not retried · gives up after 8

## Rollback
Remove the row from `cordis.patch.yml` and delete the junction. Nothing else is touched.
## Behaviour

- Only `writeText` is wrapped; `read`/`edit`/`diff` are untouched.
- Only errors whose message match

es `Win32 1175` or `ReplaceFileW` are retried.
- 8 attempts, delay `12 ms × attempt`. Worst case ≈ 3

40 ms before the original error
surfaces unchanged.
- Arguments and return value pass through untouc

hed; the error type on final failure
is the original one.

limitations: 根因说明只是工作假设，文档没有证明具体过滤驱动是原因（p9s3）。
该处理仅覆盖特定 Windows 错误和 writeText，不能消除其他写入失败（p24s1、p24s2）。
测试数据来自单一机器与卷配置（p6s1）。
output.summary_zh: 针对 Windows 文件替换操作出现的特定 Win32 1175 错误，为 DSH 的 writeText 增加有限重试，以降低短暂文件占用导致的失败。
